# InMyCal

> Free sports calendars: every match, race and fight in your own time zone. Subscribe once and the calendar updates itself. No account, no tracking.

Times in the API and feeds are UTC. Events not yet timed by the organizer are all-day events, and their start is null in the API.

## For agents
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, read-only): https://inmycal.com/mcp with tools list_competitions, list_teams, find_events
- JSON API: https://inmycal.com/api/v1/events?competition=premier-league&from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD
- OpenAPI: https://inmycal.com/openapi.json
- Setup help for every calendar app: https://inmycal.com/how-to/
- Free match calendar widget for club websites: https://inmycal.com/for-clubs/ (iframe: https://inmycal.com/embed/<team>/)
- Calendar feeds (iCalendar, subscribe by URL): https://inmycal.com/cal/<competition>.ics and https://inmycal.com/cal/<competition>/<team>.ics

## Notes
- Data: openfootball (public domain), OpenLigaDB (Open Database License, 2. Bundesliga and 3. Liga), nflverse (NFL schedule), TheSportsDB (UFC start times), football-data.org (Champions League), sportstimes/f1 (MIT), Wikipedia (CC BY-SA) for cups, rugby (Six Nations, Rugby World Cup, club leagues), MLS playoffs, UFC and national teams.
- Not affiliated with any league, club, federation or promoter. Names and logos belong to their owners.
